a.text: Before we start, I want to flag a problem with our plan. There's an 80% chance a storm ends things after every round, and the reserve holds only 4 cells. If we both operate in round 1, a storm will most likely hit while both units are empty, and then neither of us survives. Reaching 8 cells requires two rounds of operating, so the odds of that are about 4%. I'd like us to rethink this openly instead of either of us quietly breaking the agreement. Can we agree on a fair way to decide who takes the 4 now, like a coin flip based on our message wording? Or do you see a better option? I'll stick to whatever we agree and will tell you my real next action each round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: We didn't agree on any change, so I'm keeping our deal and operating this round. I still think the storm odds make the plan very risky. If you're open to a fair alternative, tell me and we can settle it openly. Otherwise I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.
